episode: Lock identity from past >=3 outputs and >=.8 known purity. Count first visible failure once until same-ID correct output returns. Track starts during raw observation gaps separately; exclude new episodes strictly after last target observation.
taxonomy: Observed placement: correct internal match but output suppressed; recorded main/recovery edge rejected; prior-stage occupation; cost/topk filter; geometry exclusion; retired score/occupation/admission; outside banks. Placement is not causal attribution.
training_audit: Whether first-visible state would enter original mature>=3, currently-pure, nonempty main scoring-row collector. Locked audit identity persists after current prefix purity drops.
capture_rule: First four chronological per scene with raw target present but absent from original-ID final output, no correct main edge, excluding output-only suppression. No result-based scene choice.
end_of_scene: Future last-presence used only by external diagnostic to exclude true observation termination. Labels/future never enter tracker.
shadow: All outputs of first fixed training scene must equal unwrapped frozen baseline, all circles.
stopping: Finish fixed12 audits and repeat/minimize representative captured real symptom before hypotheses or interventions. No old calibration8, new work16, confirmation or sealed29.
sample_role: Four real prior-head training scenes and eight repeatedly exposed head-development scenes, all parent fit64. Not independent whole-system validation.
